purpose: One medium-detail master island for both map and close scenes, with the deep rock underside of the original small islands.

assets.prompt:
Generate a new complete floating pixel-art island master sprite for use BOTH on a tiny map and in a large interactive scene.
REFERENCE 1 is PRIMARY for overall silhouette, pixel cluster size, colours and thick ROCK UNDERSIDE. Reference 2 is ONLY for the academic theme and building identity. Do NOT copy its broad flat rock slab or its over-detailed texture.
Subject: a white-stone university: a modest central blue dome, clear book crest, two compact side wings with blue roofs, broad entrance steps, just a few blue banners and warm windows. Simplify the grand palace of reference 2 into a welcoming academic campus. Do not add excessive columns, windows or ornament. Empty small fountain spot LEFT of path at x25% y57%.
Balanced MEDIUM detail, halfway between reference 1 and 2. Beautiful polished real pixel art, moderately sized crisp pixel clusters, simple readable large shapes and controlled shading. Not smooth vector, not photoreal, not blurry. Around 3-5 meaningful architectural details, a few warm windows, two broad leafy trees or bushes, a few flowers, lanterns. Avoid tiny texture noise and decorative excess.
MOST IMPORTANT: deep VOLUMETRIC faceted blue-grey rock underside EXACTLY like reference 1's floating island, with big overlapping rock chunks, bright upper-left faces, dark blue recesses, pronounced side protrusions, grass overhanging the rim. The rock mass tapers downward into a deep pointed central projection, a handsome inverted mountain silhouette. Rock section is 30-35% of the visible island height, not a flat slab, not a thin horizontal strip.
COMPOSITION: SQUARE image. Whole compact island, width about85% of image, comfortable alpha margins on all sides. Building in upper rear half, grass and paved courtyard around image y50..68%; central entrance at x50% y49%, clear landing spot x50% y62%. Enough clear foreground paving for separately animated student and furniture. Deep central rocky tip ends near y93%. Same slightly elevated frontal game perspective as reference1, sunlight upper-left, blue roofs, cream stone, warm oak, green plants. No people, foreground furniture in named empty spot, sky, text, UI, haze, matte, white outlines or cast shadow outside silhouette. True clean transparent alpha. Readable and attractive at 240px AND detailed enough at 1100px. One image for all zoom levels.
